Baskin Financial Services Cut Holding in Apple (AAPL) as Stock Declined; Oceanic Investment Management LTD Maintains Holding in Capital Product Partners LP (CPLP) 
April 20, 2018 - By Vivian Park 
Oceanic Investment Management Ltd increased its stake in Capital Product Partners LP (CPLP) by 11.35% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Oceanic Investment Management Ltd bought 124,900 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.37% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.22 million shares of the marine transportation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.12M, up from 1.10 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Oceanic Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Capital Product Partners LP for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $423.39M market cap company. The stock increased 0.45% or $0.0147 during the last trading session, reaching $3.2647. About 101,510 shares traded. Capital Product Partners L.P. (NASDAQ:CPLP) has declined 6.55% since April 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 18.10% the S&P500. 
Baskin Financial Services Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 1.42% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baskin Financial Services Inc sold 2,357 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 163,522 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $27.67 million, down from 165,879 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baskin Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $849.44 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 3.12% or $5.3898 during the last trading session, reaching $167.4102. About 27.27M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Among 54 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 35 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive. Apple Inc. had 394 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Bernstein on Thursday, August 20 with “Buy”. Pacific Crest maintained the stock with “Equal Weight” rating in Friday, September 11 report. The rating was maintained by Drexel Hamilton on Friday, June 9 with “Buy”. Robert W. Baird maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Tuesday, September 5 with “Buy” rating. Morgan Stanley maintained the stock with “Overweight” rating in Wednesday, October 26 report. Citigroup maintained it with “Buy” rating and $120 target in Wednesday, July 27 report. The firm has “Overweight” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets given on Monday, October 16. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) earned “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Wednesday, October 28. The rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets on Monday, July 24 with “Buy”. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Buy” rating given on Monday, March 5 by RBC Capital Markets. 
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75 billion for 15.44 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth. 
Investors sentiment increased to 0.73 in Q4 2017. Its up 0.03, from 0.7 in 2017Q3. It is positive, as 50 investors sold AAPL shares while 1023 reduced holdings. 151 funds opened positions while 637 raised stakes. 2.98 billion shares or 0.18% more from 2.97 billion shares in 2017Q3 were reported. State Bank Of America Corp De invested 1.12% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). The Massachusetts-based Woodstock Corp has invested 1.91% in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Focused Wealth owns 25,687 shares for 1.39% of their portfolio. Cutter & Co Brokerage stated it has 11,685 shares or 0.81% of all its holdings. Jennison Assoc Ltd accumulated 25.07 million shares or 4.19% of the stock. Clearbridge Invests Ltd reported 6.89 million shares stake. Nikko Asset Mngmt Americas has invested 1.47% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Sky Lc holds 0.09% in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) or 1,316 shares. Gam Hldgs Ag accumulated 62,834 shares. Newfocus Fincl Grp Inc Limited Liability Corp owns 77,979 shares or 8.04% of their US portfolio. Beach Inv Mngmt Ltd Liability Co holds 2.77% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) for 10,690 shares. Columbia Asset Mngmt has invested 4.49% in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Glenview Financial Bank Trust Dept, a Illinois-based fund reported 76,726 shares. Boston Private Wealth Limited Liability owns 795,005 shares. Penobscot Investment invested in 44,672 shares. 
Baskin Financial Services Inc, which manages about $527.27M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Bank Of Nova Scotia (NYSE:BNS) by 4,829 shares to 263,809 shares, valued at $17.10 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Delta Air Lines Inc. (NYSE:DAL) by 15,590 shares in the quarter, for a total of 165,409 shares, and has risen its stake in Becton Dickinson And Co (NYSE:BDX). 
Since December 7, 2017, it had 0 insider buys, and 4 sales for $19.89 million activity. Riccio Daniel J. also sold $2.73 million worth of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Friday, January 5.
